title: Learning to Drive in New Cities Without Human Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2602.15891v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While autonomous vehicles have achieved reliable performance within specific operating regions, their deployment to new cities remains costly and slow. A key bottleneck is the need to collect many human demonstration trajectories when adapting driving policies to new cities that differ from those seen in training in terms of road geometry, traffic rules, and interaction patterns. In this paper, we show that self-play multi-agent reinforcement learning can adapt a driving policy to a substantially different target city using only the map and meta-information, without requiring any human demonstrations from that city. We introduce NO data Map-based self-play for Autonomous Driving (NOMAD), which enables policy adaptation in a simulator constructed based on the target-city map. translated_title: 无需人类示范学习在新城市中驾驶
translated_abstract: 虽然自动驾驶汽车在特定运行区域内已实现可靠性能，但将其部署到新城市仍然成本高昂且进展缓慢。一个关键瓶颈在于：当将驾驶策略适配到与训练城市在道路几何结构、交通规则和交互模式方面存在差异的新城市时，需要收集大量人类示范轨迹。在本文中，我们证明了自博弈多智能体强化学习可以仅利用地图和元信息，将驾驶策略适配到一个差异显著的目标城市，而无需来自该城市的任何人类示范。我们提出了面向自动驾驶的无数据基于地图的自博弈方法（NOMAD），该方法能够在基于目标城市地图构建的模拟器中实现策略适配。使用简单的奖励函数，NOMAD显著提升了目标城市的任务成功率和轨迹真实性，展示了一种有效的……
tldr: 提出NOMAD方法，通过自博弈多智能体强化学习，仅利用目标城市的地图和元信息即可将驾驶策略适配到新城市，完全无需该城市的人类示范轨迹。
en_tdlr: NOMAD enables cross-city driving policy adaptation via self-play multi-agent reinforcement learning, requiring only the target city's map and meta-information without any human demonstrations.
